title: dog howling
author: simcotter
changes: Husky (Canis familiaris) giving one long howl, described by the recordist as a recording of a husky dog howling. Trimmed to 9.12–11.50 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. The 70 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency rumble; the howl itself sits at about 250 Hz and above.
